name: NEMA 5-15
description: North American 2-pole, 3-wire grounding plug and receptacle rated 15 A, 125 V: two flat parallel blades and a round or U-shaped ground pin.

variants.name: NEMA 5-15P plug
mechanicalNotes: Blades 6.3–6.4 mm wide, 1.5 mm thick, 15.9–18.3 mm long, 12.7 mm between centres.
Ground pin 4.8 mm in diameter, 3.2 mm longer than the blades, 11.9 mm from the blade line.

notes: Ratings rely on secondary sources and the face layout on secondary sources and a manufacturer chart; ANSI/NEMA WD 6 was not reviewed.
Frequency is not stated by the cited sources.
The receptacle drawing shows the ground hole as a circle: its exact D shape is not drawn.
The hot and neutral sides of the receptacle drawing follow Wikipedia and the 5-15R face diagram of the Hubbell NEMA configuration chart (neutral W marked); the dimensions come from WorldStandards.

The plug drawing follows the 5-15P face diagram of the Hubbell NEMA configuration chart (ground pin up, neutral blade W on the left), rotated 180° to show the ground pin down like the receptacle drawing; blade and pin proportions follow the dimensions above. The ground pin is drawn as a circle and the body outline is not to scale.
